title: Quintessentially Qazi Portuguese Five Spice Lamb Bake
description: A sattvic-friendly, comforting dish featuring a flavorful lamb filling and a crusty, puffed bread crust, all in a traditional Portuguese-inspired style. Perfect for a lazy Sunday afternoon.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless and cut into 1.5-inch pieces
Portuguese piment8n
ingredients.notes: store-bought or made fresh in advance

ingredients.name: Bread, cubed (white or whole wheat, or gluten-free alternative)

instructions: In a large cauldron or Dutch oven, heat the coconut oil over medium heat. Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
In a small bowl, mix together the piment8n, turmeric, garam masala, and five-spice powder. Add this spice blend to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the browned lamb back into the pot and stir to coat with the spice blend.
Add the chopped cilantro, bread, and water to the pot. Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown and the filling is heated through.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the Quintessentially Qazi Portuguese Five Spice Lamb Bake hot, garnished with additional chopped cilantro if desired.
If desired, serve with a side of saut�eded greens or a simple salad for a well-rounded meal.
Enjoy your delicious and comforting dish!
